description: This file contains test code for a FastAPI application, testing API endpoints and OpenAPI schema using pytest and TestClient. It imports application modules dynamically, runs endpoint request tests, and validates the OpenAPI schema JSON structure.

classes.name: TestClient
classes.description: A class provided by FastAPI to simulate client requests to the app during testing.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Pytest fixture that dynamically imports the application module based on the request parameter and returns a TestClient instance for making HTTP requests.

methods.name: test_post_body_example(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test function that sends a PUT request to update an item, verifying a 200 status response.

methods.name: test_openapi_schema(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Test function that retrieves and validates the OpenAPI JSON schema from the running application.
